card.fires_on: The first piece "nit" of words like nitrofurantoin, nitrite and nitrates, mostly in lists of drug interactions or lab test interference. It also fires weakly on other word starts such as "oxygen" and "lact" before a word ending.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing the word with endings like -ate, -ated and -ation.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of nitrite and nitrate type words, getting ready for the word to be completed.
